title: Suggestion request
description: What the application sends to the workspace-suggestion agent: one customer sentence, the slot rules, and the currency to think in. The catalogue is NOT carried - the agent searches it through the MCP tools it was given, so what the agent may choose from is whatever those tools return.

runId.description: Opaque identifier for this run. Carried so the application can record it; it is not an identity.

query.description: The customer's own words, verbatim. The only free text that crosses to Foundry.

currency.description: Stated once, because the catalogue holds one currency.

ceilingMonthly.description: The monthly ceiling the customer named, when they named one. Null when they did not - the agent must not invent one.

slots.description: The slots and how many of each a composition may hold.
